scope: Original PC sprite setup/clipping through the first instruction before C8F0/CAB0 pixel loops; bounded C89 proposal and finite fixtures.

oracle.source_state: unpatched original; mapped read/execute for bounded emulator cases

abi.AC60: one 32-bit ordering-table pointer; AC60 stages packets in fixed globals and invokes rasterizers with no stack arguments.
abi.C8F0_CAB0: no-argument internal routines; plain RET, no return value; preserve EBP/EBX/ESI/EDI. No calls in either bounded body.

sprite_0x64.extent: raw u16 words at +0x10/+0x12, sign-extended by rasterizer

packet_and_page_inputs.fixed_sprite_0x74: 8x8 staged by AC60; packet dimensions are not read
packet_and_page_inputs.fixed_sprite_0x7C: 16x16 staged by AC60; packet dimensions are not read
packet_and_page_inputs.selected_page: AC60 stores 0x96E6E0+(((A8E6F4&0x1F)>>1)<<16) in A909FC, overridden with 0xA6E6E0 if A8E6FC!=0

gate_and_surface.43A48C: dynamic bottom boundary; right is immediate 320

inputs.A90A0C: width word, consumed as signed i16
inputs.A90A10: height word, consumed as signed i16
inputs.A909FC: selected page base, overwritten with page+u on prepared paths

outputs.A90944: destination start = surface + y*pitch + x; written only after positive clipped extents
outputs.A909FC: selected page + adjusted U; written only after positive clipped extents
outputs.[EBP-4]: first source row V<<8; local stack value before loop

order: return on draw gate zero, surface null, x>=320, or y>=43A48C
sign-extend width/height and reject if x+width<0 or y+height<0
clip negative x/y by shrinking extent, adding -x/-y to U/V without byte masking, and setting coordinate to zero
prepare destination/page/row pointers; C8F0 also prepares blend table
geometry_contract.empty_mutations: Top/left clipping writes to x/y, extent, U/V persist when clipping produces an empty rectangle; destination/page/blend/row setup is skipped.
geometry_contract.source_address: page+U+(V<<8)+column at first row; subsequent row offset adds 0x100 then masks to 0xFFFF (static sites CA7C/CA86 and CC13/CC1D).

fixture.result: PASS; VC5 C89 compile and runtime

bounded_c_proposal.layout_checks: sizeof(renderer_sprite_geometry)==48; offsetof x=0, width_word=4, u_offset=8, selected_page_base=16, destination_start=32

limits: The C files are candidate-only helper and fixture, not canonical renderer changes.
Native suite stops before both pixel loops; pixel behavior is separately receipted in work/renderer_next/pixel_oracles/native_report.json.
No complete VRAM backing extent, source ownership, or full renderer equivalence is claimed.
